definitions.explanation: To cook food by submerging it in hot oil. Written with the kanji {揚|あ} to distinguish from other verbs read あげる.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧カラッ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{揚|あ}げる。
examples.english: I deep-fry the chicken until crispy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高温|こうおん}→高温：14705_kouon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{揚|あ}げる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The trick to tempura is frying it in high-temperature oil.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{揚|あ}げた⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧サクサク、⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ふわふわ→ふわふわ：05156_fuwafuwa⟧だ。
examples.english: The croquettes my mother deep-fried are crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside.

notes:
{揚|あ}げる specifically means to deep-fry — to cook food by submerging it in hot oil. The kanji {揚|あ} distinguishes this verb from the many other ⟦あげる→あげる：00546_ageru⟧ verbs.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: ⟦{揚|あ}がる→揚がる：28726_agaru⟧ (intransitive — food is fried, comes out of oil)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揚|あ}げる

ASPECT (ている):
{揚|あ}げて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means "is in the process of deep-frying."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{揚|あ}げる: to fry in oil
- カラッ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{揚|あ}げる: to fry until crispy
- ⟦{素揚|すあ}げ→素揚げ：17176_suage⟧: deep-frying without batter
- ⟦{揚|あ}げたて→揚げたて：16736_agetate⟧: freshly fried

FRIED FOODS:
- ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: tempura (batter-fried)
- ⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧: Japanese fried chicken
- ⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧: croquette
- ⟦フライ→フライ：11124_furai⟧: deep-fried breaded food (tonkatsu, etc.)

OTHER あげる VERBS:
- ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise
- ⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to cite, to hold up
- {掲|あ}げる: to display, to hoist
